item.title: [News] Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
item.description: Nvidia has announced new open AI models designed for enterprise deployment in data centers and on individual PCs. These models aim to enable private, on-device AI agents that can operate without cloud connectivity.

item.title: [News] Securing the agentic insider
item.description: Microsoft warns that increasingly powerful AI models pose significant insider threat risks, urging tighter safeguards against agentic misuse. The alert underscores the need for enhanced monitoring of AI-driven activities within corporate environments.

item.title: [News] The Download: preserving the Arctic permafrost, and playful AI agents
item.description: MIT Tech Review’s newsletter discusses efforts to preserve Arctic permafrost and mentions playful AI agents in the context of environmental technology.

item.title: [News] Why Data Modeling Is Not Enough
item.description: A MIT Sloan article discusses the limitations of relying solely on data modeling for operational decisions, emphasizing the need for holistic approaches that combine data science with broader business context.

item.title: [News] Anthropic says it’s committing 5% of its shares to a ‘public benefit fund’
item.description: Anthropic announced it will allocate 5% of its shares to a public benefit fund, a move aimed at supporting broader societal impacts.
